surface: Handrail hinged HTML trifold and partnership proposal notes
scope: Current trifold revision verified locally; publication and final user visual acceptance pending. No full global certification is claimed.

notes: The proposal opens a broader working relationship. New business is the starting point, with room for Brent's contribution to grow; no specific future title is promised. No base salary, collections-based commission, 15/5 versus 20/5, all future credited sales and the 90-day window remain explicit. Handrail prepares the final contract.
Current chapter, camera progress and Read normally / Take the tour labels expose the active presentation state.
The cash receipt explains money received before commission; retained funds explicitly exclude delivery, benefits and other costs.
Chapter buttons, a persisted reading preference, direct proposal notes and a matching PDF let readers bypass the camera journey.
The actual Handrail wordmark, warm paper/rust palette and locally served Inter/Playfair typography establish a coherent brand treatment.
Content is explicitly a proposal for discussion. No signature or acceptance mechanism exists; unagreed qualifying-client and benefits details remain discussion points.
Rates have explicit collected-fee labels; notes provide a linked seven-section table of contents.
Readers can select chapters, use ordinary scrolling or open the notes and PDF directly.

The actual semantic HTML proposal forms three hinged panels with front/back faces. Local rendered review covered the folded cover, left/right opening stages, full spread and reading holds. Decorative symbols and the old separate paper sculpture are removed. This is reviewer assessment, not user acceptance.
No-JavaScript and system reduced-motion paths retain the complete proposal in ordinary document flow. No renderer or WebGL dependency remains.
Concise proposal notes explain the commercial structure, requested support and discussion points without legal boilerplate.
Reviewed desktop stops emphasize no base salary, collection timing and the two build rates.

19 browser checks passed. The capture receipt contains 24 desktop/mobile chapter views and 15 actual-scroll samples, with zero errors, warnings or failed requests. Active reading faces are flat and framed; minimum captured reading text is 14.05px. Both hinges change with wheel input and reverse. Ordinary reading reflows at 320/390/768/1440.
Automated app and three component checks have zero axe violations. Manual VoiceOver and physical-device review remain unperformed.
Proposed status, commission timing, benefits cost and visible presentation controls are stated plainly.

Current trifold local Lighthouse scores are 100 in performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO on both devices. Mobile LCP is 1656.355ms, TBT 0ms and CLS 0.02279675; desktop LCP is 368.8312ms, TBT 0ms and CLS 0.01910344. Physical-device performance and field INP remain unmeasured.
Measured route script transfer is 46,763 bytes (120,036 resource bytes).
No forms.
No text inputs or paste interception.

Current browser checks cover keyboard chapter navigation, mode switching, skip-link activation and focusing an offscreen document link, which restores ordinary reading. This is checked local-flow coverage, not exhaustive manual assistive-technology certification.
Emulated viewports do not establish physical notched-device coverage.
System reduced motion selects ordinary reading with no camera transform. A saved reading preference survives reload and motion-preference changes.

One ScrollTrigger timeline opens both hinges sequentially, then coordinates camera pullbacks, 3D rotation and panel movement between flat reading holds. A numeric camera composes uniform CSS scale3d so hinge depth scales with the document. Scrolling back reverses the scene; ordinary reading removes transforms.
24 chapter captures across desktop, mobile and small mobile were inspected. Browser checks enforce target framing and readable type; the minimum captured reading size is 14.05px.
Rates and the illustrative payment arithmetic are checked; the 90-day window is a proposal term, not a live countdown.
No live date or locale-sensitive client rendering.
An emulated mobile touch gesture advances the tour in browser QA. Physical-device interaction remains unverified.
The notes route presents the canonical introduction, seven sections, 15 paragraphs and endnote. PDF generation and rendered-document verification are tracked in the current release receipts.
Rendered rate numerals retain associated percentage and collected-fee labels.
Native buttons and links, named navigation, headings and landmarks expose the camera and reading paths through the DOM.
Static app; no API, database, authentication or business mutation states.
